Hadara Alook

Growth Strategist at Mayple

“I love that Mayple respects the quality of my work rather than when or where I am doing it from.”

WE’RE ON A MISSION...

To create a new world of marketing where everyone thrives

Working at Mayple is as bold as it is rewarding. Mayple was built to empower online businesses and top eCommerce marketing talent to match up, collaborate, and grow together.

We’re creating the opportunity for eCommerce brands to access an enormous  wealth of talent. And a select few of these talented marketers will have the exact skills, niche knowledge, track record, personality, and approach these brands need to work in harmony with them and help them scale.
Mayple is here to help both sides thrive and fulfill their potential.

Guided by our four core values, we’ll grow together with our brand and marketing partners  And with you, too, when you join us

Why we did it? Because the world of work is rapidly changing. Top marketers now have the freedom to build independent and flexible work arrangements. And we have the ability to measure the true performance of that talent, based on what they do and deliver—not based on where they live or how well they sell themselves.

WHAT MAYPLERS ARE MADE OF
